progress_method: 5-year average: the one NASS prints in the weekly Crop Progress report where a figure carries avg5_by NASS (the national row and the states in the report; for 2021-2025 NASS used its own estimates for the October 2025 weeks it did not publish). Elsewhere AGSIST's arithmetic on the NASS weekly series, each of the five prior years interpolated to the same calendar date, then averaged; withheld if any year lacks a published week on both sides, and can differ from the NASS-printed average by a point.
